acceptance: Every absence kind in the code is mapped to a reason string; a test fails if a new absence kind has no mapping.

Given real captured payloads (429 Cloud Code Assist JSON, gateway unreachable, incomplete read), the posted pending body, a SHIP WITH FIXES body with a quota-absent attempt, and the status contain no provider payload text and no string matching common key patterns (sk-, Bearer, tskey-).
Two consecutive not-reviewed results with the same cause on the same head post one review; a changed cause posts again; an unparseable previous post leads to a new post (tests).
Each cause renders its specific next step (table-driven test).
The body keeps the current heading and `**Reviewers not available**` title, and local output keeps the `availability: ` prefix (tests).
Merged to Theseus main with hosted SHIP + green required checks + independent review SHIP on the final head (recorded here).
context: Part of theseus-review-output-format-20261110. Ships in release A.
description:
When no reviewer produces a verdict, Theseus posts a 'Reviewers not available' review that includes truncated raw provider JSON (public leak), repeats on every retry of the same head (BenchBox #4067 got two identical ones), and gives no next step. The same raw text also appears in the 'Reviewers not available' and 'Provider availability' sections inside SHIP / SHIP WITH FIXES bodies.
Change: map every absence kind to a short human reason (provider quota, gateway unreachable, did not read every changed hunk, invalid answer, timeout, too large, run artifacts failed validation, edited review); raw provider text goes only to the run log and uploaded artifacts. Applies to pending bodies and to those sections inside verdict bodies.
De-duplication: write a hidden marker `<!-- review-unavailable: v1 <40hex> <cause-key> -->` on not-reviewed posts and compare markers only, never prose; skip the post when the latest bot post for the same head carries the same marker; an unreadable or missing previous marker means post again (fail toward posting). Add the marker to the grammar page from theseus-review-markers-dual-read-20261110.
Next step by cause: transient causes say the hourly sweep retries and a maintainer can comment `/review`; oversize says split the PR or ask an owner for a stand-in; edited review says push a new head.
In release A keep the current heading `### review-verdict: pending for `<sha>``, the bold section title `**Reviewers not available**` (BenchBox soundness_merge_digest.py:80 KNOWN_CLOSED_SECTIONS) and the local `availability: ` prefix (local.py:101, parsed by BenchBox make/pr-landing.mk); change only the reason text and the next-step line.
Guardrails: the pending verdict status and the gate's decision are unchanged; hourly retry/backoff and owner reset behaviour are unchanged (Theseus #55 semantics); no secret or token text can reach GitHub; no live model calls; Theseus merge rule (hosted SHIP + CI) plus independent review (changes posting).
